passage:
Dear Mr. Beaumont,

I bought a new car from your dealership six months ago. I really like the car, but I am having a serious problem with the touch screen, and I am worried about my safety and the safety of my family.

While I am driving, the screen sometimes goes black and then restarts by itself. When this happens, the blind-spot warning and the back-up sensors stop working. The cruise control also turns off without any sound or message. Last week, this happened twice while I was changing lanes. I did not get any warning, and I almost hit another car.

I have taken the car to your service department three times. Each time, the technician, David, told me it was a small problem with my phone connection and said the car was fine. On March 12, he also told me that there were no error messages in the system. However, I have a video from my dashboard camera that shows the problem clearly, and I gave a copy to your staff at that visit.

I do not want another reset or a quick software update, because those fixes have not worked before. I would like a senior technician to look at the car and fix the problem for good, even if that means replacing a part. I also hope someone can explain to me why this keeps happening.

Could you please call me by Friday to set up an appointment? I can bring the car in any morning next week. I would like to solve this with your dealership, but I may need to contact the car company directly if the problem continues.

Thank you for taking my concern seriously. I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Sincerely,
Lawrence Thorne
